marking.criterion: BDF defined as domain:bus:device.function, the enumeration address of a PCIe function
Explains why it is not the slot: bus numbers are assigned at enumeration by firmware/OS and can change (BIOS change, platform differences)
Two slot sources given (lspci -vmm PhySlot / lspci -v Physical Slot, dmidecode -t slot, /sys/bus/pci/slots/*/address)
